subject: Onboarding credential crosswalk & sample evidence request
messages:
From: Lara Hewitt <l.hewitt@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Systems Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Preboarding evidence: request for sample artifacts and crosswalk

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As part of our SIG and SOC 2 preparation we're collecting a small sample set from vendors to validate personnel controls around onboarding and offboarding (background checks, role-based training, access deprovisioning timelines).

Could you provide: 
- A short crosswalk showing where Redwood maps to our SIG control identifiers (particularly HR-3/HR-4/HR-5)
- Sample training completion records for a cohort of new hires (redact PII where necessary)
- The bg-check / verification log for that cohort (redacted)

If you can share a drive link or a consolidated spreadsheet that lists the artifacts and the exact place in your policies where they live, that would speed our review. We prefer PDFs or CSVs for ingest.

Target: we'd like to include Redwood in the package going to Acme's auditors next Tuesday (2026-12-01).

Thanks,
Lara
Lara Hewitt
Security Program Manager
Acme Health Systems

Attachments: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Hewitt <l.hewitt@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Preboarding evidence: request for sample artifacts and crosswalk

Hi Lara — thanks for outlining the scope. I can get you a compact crosswalk and redacted artifacts. Looping in Marissa (People Ops) for the training/verification exports and Priyom (InfoSec) for any policy mappings and redaction guidance.

Plan: 
1) Marissa will export a 30-person sample training completion CSV and the associated training matrix (we'll redact emails).
2) We'll attach a redacted background-check log PDF that shows verification statuses (no SSNs).
3) Priyom will produce a one-page mapping that ties Redwood onboarding steps to SIG/SOC2 HR controls.

Deliverables ETA: I’ll assemble into a single preboarding_crosswalk.xlsx and share a Drive folder by Thursday EOD (2026-11-26). If you need a different format, let us know.

-Marcus
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lara Hewitt <l.hewitt@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Preboarding evidence: request for sample artifacts and crosswalk

Thanks Marcus — starting the export now. A few notes on scope so we all align: 
- Sample cohort = hires between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-15 (this keeps the sample recent and includes both remote and on-site hires).
- Records we will provide: training_matrix_v3.csv (course ids, completion date, role), bg-check-log.pdf (status, vendor reference, verification date; redacted to initials + hire id), and a short HR narrative that explains our ID verification workflow.
- Redaction policy: we will remove SSN and exact DOB, keep initials + employee ID, and mask email domains.

I expect the CSV + PDF + narrative in the Drive folder by 2026-11-26 18:00 UTC. Attaching a stub list here: training_matrix_v3.csv (CSV), bg-check-log.pdf (PDF).

Marissa Cole
Sr. People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (will be uploaded to Drive): training_matrix_v3.csv, bg-check-log.pdf

From: Lara Hewitt <l.hewitt@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Preboarding evidence: request for sample artifacts and crosswalk

Thanks — that timeline works. A couple of quick clarifications before you assemble the crosswalk: 
- For the bg-check log, our auditors expect a column showing the vendor used (e.g., CheckCorp) and a clearance result (pass/exception). Keeping vendor names is fine.
- For training records, can you flag which courses are mandatory for engineers vs. non-engineers? A single role column is fine.
- In the crosswalk sheet, if you can include the exact policy section (e.g., "Onboarding — ID verification, section 3.2") that would make mapping easier.

If you hit any redaction issues, let me know and we can accept a redacted sample PLUS an attest letter from HR describing the redaction approach.

Appreciate the quick turn — Lara

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Hewitt <l.hewitt@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Preboarding evidence: request for sample artifacts and crosswalk

Hi all — uploaded the consolidated package to the Drive link and attached the crosswalk spreadsheet to this thread for quick reference. Summary notes below: 

- preboarding_crosswalk.xlsx (attached): tabs = 1) Crosswalk (SIG/SOC2 control -> Redwood artifact + policy link), 2) TrainingSample (30 rows, role, course ids, completion status), 3) BGsample (redacted status log).
- Training: mandatory courses for engineers = Secure Coding, Data Handling Basics, Phishing Awareness. Non-engineer mandatory = Data Handling Basics, Privacy Basics. These are flagged in TrainingSample.
- Background checks: vendor = CheckCorp; columns = vendor_ref, verification_date, result (PASS/EXCEPTION). Exceptions are annotated with remediation steps.
- Redaction: per Marissa's note — SSNs removed, DOB month/year only, emails masked. HR provided an attestation document in the Drive folder confirming redaction approach and chain-of-custody for copies provided to auditors.

If Acme would like a signed attestation PDF for their bundle, say so and I’ll have Legal/HR sign off. Otherwise, the Drive folder and the attached crosswalk should be sufficient for your auditors.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: preboarding_crosswalk.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-crosswalk
